info.title: Billu Bazaar Mobile Customer API
info.description: Customer APIs organized by feature. Log in with the existing mobile Auth API and use its token in Authorize. All feature routes require customer authentication.

bearerAuth.description: Mobile access token returned by /mob-api/auth/login or /register. Paste without the Bearer prefix.

post.description: Registers a new customer account, enforces unique email and unique phone number, awards loyalty bonus points, and returns a 10-year access token.

message.example: Customer registered successfully

400.description: Validation failure (missing field / invalid email / weak password / invalid phone)

message.example: Please enter a valid email address

409.description: Conflict — Email or Phone number already registered

message.example: This phone number is already registered
Internal server error

post.description: Authenticates customer by email and password, returning a 10-year access token embedded with customer profile and cartCount.

200.description: Login successful

message.example: Login successful
Email and password are required

401.description: Incorrect password

message.example: Incorrect password
Your account has been deactivated. Please contact customer support.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Product name search text. Required on /products/search; optional on /products.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Active category ID. Unknown IDs return 404; incompatible category/subcategory pairs return 400.

parameters.name: subCategoryId
parameters.description: Active subcategory ID. Unknown IDs return 404; incompatible category/subcategory pairs return 400.

parameters.name: minPrice
parameters.description: Inclusive INR product price bound. Uses product price, not individual variant prices.

parameters.name: maxPrice
parameters.description: Inclusive INR product price bound. Uses product price, not individual variant prices.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: new-arrivals, best-sellers, or featured. Comma-separated values match any selected collection; other filters still apply.

parameters.name: minDiscount
parameters.description: Inclusive discount percentage bound. Calculated from product price and comparePrice, rounded to a whole percentage. Products without a discount count as 0%.

parameters.name: maxDiscount
parameters.description: Inclusive discount percentage bound. Calculated from product price and comparePrice, rounded to a whole percentage. Products without a discount count as 0%.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Price low to high, price high to low, newest first, or highest rating first.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page, starting at 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum products per page. The mobile request middleware caps larger limits at 100.

200.description: Products and pagination, or an empty products array when no matches exist

400.description: Invalid filter values, reversed ranges, missing search query, or a subcategory outside the selected category

401.description: Missing or invalid customer access token

404.description: Selected category or subcategory does not exist or is inactive

500.description: Unable to fetch products due to a server error

shippingAddress.description: Inline address requires name (or fullName), phone, address (or flatHouse), city, state, pincode and country. Email defaults to the signed-in customer email.

billingAddress.description: Inline address requires name (or fullName), phone, address (or flatHouse), city, state, pincode and country. Email defaults to the signed-in customer email.

post.description: Create an order from your saved cart, or an explicit buyNowItem. Use an owned shippingAddressId and optional billingAddressId, or inline addresses. Delivery requires an Indian address with a six-digit pincode. Prices, stock, discounts, shipping and tax are validated/calculated by the server. Saved addresses are copied into the order. Online orders require the initiate and verify payment steps; COD follows existing checkout rules.
